patterns.title: permission denied
patterns.explain: Your token's policy doesn't allow that path or operation, or you're in the wrong namespace.
patterns.fix: bao token lookup shows your policies, and the path in the error shows what was refused. Check the path and the namespace before anything else.

patterns.title: no token
patterns.explain: You aren't logged in (or this shell has no BAO_TOKEN).
patterns.fix: Log in the way the lab shows, then try again.

patterns.title: can't reach the server
patterns.explain: The address in BAO_ADDR doesn't answer: a typo, or the service is still starting.
patterns.fix: echo $BAO_ADDR and compare it with the lab. If it's right, wait a few seconds and retry, then tell the facilitator.
